items.title: eMudhra to exit global SSL/TLS certificate business
items.summary: 📝 Will Sharpen Focus on Core Enterprise Solutions and trust services other than SSL/TLS BENGALURU, INDIA, October 22, 2026 - eMudhra Limited (BSE: 543533 | NSE: EMUDHRA), a global digital trust company, today announced that its Board has decided to voluntarily withdraw from the global SSL/TLS certificate business. He added that global SSL/TLS is a small part of eMudhra’s business contributing to about 1% of the global revenue. Core businesses unaffected eMudhra’s global SSL/TLS infrastructure runs separately from its other operations.🔗 Read more: https://emudhra.com/en/press-release/emudhra-to-exit-global-ssl-tls-certificate-business
